Junior Civil Drafter - Global Rail Infrastructure Team
Perth, WA | 3 months contract
About the role
An exciting opportunity has become available for a Junior Civil Drafter to join a globally connected Rail Infrastructure team based in Perth.
This position is ideal for a recent graduate or early career drafter looking to develop their technical skills and build a long-term career within a collaborative engineering environment. You'll gain exposure to major rail and civil infrastructure projects, working alongside experienced specialists delivering projects from concept through to construction across Australia and internationally.
Key Responsibilities
 - Prepare accurate 2D and 3D drawings for rail and civil infrastructure projects.
 - Develop rail alignment plans, longitudinal sections, cross-sections and track layout drawings.
 - Produce drawings for earthworks, drainage, and associated civil infrastructure.
 - Prepare Issued for Construction (IFC) documentation in line with project requirements and industry standards.
 - Manage drawing revisions and incorporate design updates throughout project delivery.
 - Maintain drawing registers and support document control processes.
 - Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure quality and consistency across project deliverables.
About You
 - Certificate or Diploma in Civil Engineering Drafting or equivalent qualification.
 - Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or MicroStation.
 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality documentation.
 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings, standards and specifications.
 - Strong communication and teamwork skills.
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet project deadlines.
About Airswift
Airswift is an international workforce solutions provider within the energy, process and infrastructure industries. Airswift serves as a strategic partner to our clients, offering a turnkey workforce solution to capture and deliver the top talent needed to complete successful projects by aligning with the unique needs of our clients.
With over 1000 employees and 9,000+ contractors operating in over 130 countries, our geographical reach and pool of talent available is unmatched in the industry and the level of experience, exposure and expertise that the organization has is unparalleled.
Only candidates with the right to work in Australia will be considered. (Australia Citizen, PR Holder, or Valid Australia working VISA)
If you would like to be considered for the position, please apply directly to this advertisement or send your application via email to kashmera.vijayakumaran@airswift.com with your updated CV/ resume & contact details. Alternatively, you may contact Kash at +61 08 6256 0338 for more information.

candidates.content_text:
Kickstart Your Career in Engineering Drafting!
Ready to turn your interest in design and engineering into a career?
Whether you’re finishing Year 12, recently left school or studying Civil Drafting at TAFE, this is your opportunity to get started in the engineering industry.
STP Consultants is looking for an enthusiastic Junior Civil Draftsperson to join our growing Brisbane team. You’ll work alongside experienced civil engineers and drafters, gain hands-on experience and learn how the drawings you create become part of real projects across Queensland.
You don’t need years of experience. We’re looking for someone with the right attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn.
Why you’ll love working here
Start building your career
Get hands-on experience from day one and develop practical civil drafting skills while learning from experienced engineers and drafters.
Work on real projects
Go beyond the classroom and see how civil engineering projects come together. You’ll contribute to drawings and documentation used throughout projects from concept and design through to delivery.
Learn from experienced people
Ask questions, share ideas and learn from people who genuinely want to help you develop. You’ll receive guidance and mentoring as your skills and confidence grow.
Be part of a great team
Join a close-knit, collaborative team where people support each other, work together and enjoy what they do.
Work in Fortitude Valley
Our Brisbane office is in the heart of Fortitude Valley, close to public transport, cafés, restaurants and everything the city has to offer.
The Opportunity 
As you develop your skills, you’ll have the opportunity to:
- Assist with preparing civil drawings, plans and project documentation.
- Work with engineers and experienced drafters to produce clear, accurate and high-quality drawings.
- Learn industry standards, guidelines and best-practice drafting processes.
- Develop your understanding of how civil engineering projects are designed and delivered.
- Participate in project discussions and meetings to build your understanding of project requirements.
- Carry out basic drawing and documentation checks with guidance from experienced team members.
- Take on more responsibility as your skills and confidence develop.
About you:
You could be a great fit if you are:
- A Year 12 student, recent school leaver or currently studying Civil Drafting at TAFE.
- Genuinely interested in civil drafting, design and engineering.
- Curious and keen to learn new skills.
- Detail-oriented and take pride in producing accurate work.
- A good communicator who is comfortable asking questions and taking feedback.
- Reliable, organized and willing to have a go at new challenges.
- Someone who enjoys working with others and being part of a team.
- An Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident.
Most importantly, bring your enthusiasm and willingness to learn. We’ll help you turn it into a career.
What’s in it for you?
- 
Career development: Build your skills through hands-on experience, mentoring and ongoing professional development.
- 
Flexibility: Enjoy a 9-day fortnight, flexible working hours and the option to purchase additional leave.
- 
Competitive remuneration: A package that reflects your experience and contribution.
- 
Recognition and rewards: Employee referral rewards and recognition programs.
- 
Great culture: Work with supportive people in a friendly, collaborative environment, with regular team and social events.
- 
Wellbeing support: Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program.
- 
Long-term opportunity: Build your career with an established, Australian-owned engineering consultancy.
About STP Consultants 
For more than 20 years, STP Consultants has been helping shape communities across Queensland. We’re a privately owned, multidisciplinary engineering consultancy, bringing together expertise across Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Hydraulic, Fire and Seismic engineering. 
Our teams work on a diverse range of projects across Queensland, giving you the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals and see the many different paths an engineering career can take.
Our values of Potential, Respect, Integrity, Deliver and Engage shape the way we work with our clients and with each other.
We’re proud of our approachable leaders, supportive team environment and commitment to developing people and delivering quality engineering outcomes.
Ready to get started?  
If you’re looking for more than just a first job and want to build a career in engineering, we’d love to hear from you.
Click Apply and send us your Resume and Cover Letter.
In your cover letter, tell us:
1. Why you’re interested in starting a career in civil drafting.  2. What interests you about joining STP Consultants.
STP Consultants is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

candidates.content_text:
Build your career with an organisation that is invested in your success. 
Maker Consulting Services is looking for a motivated Civil Engineering Undergraduate or Graduate to join our growing Newcastle team. Whether you're currently studying and looking to gain meaningful industry experience alongside university; or completing your degree and ready to begin your graduate career, this role offers the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing to real projects from day one. 
You'll work alongside experienced engineers on land development, infrastructure, roads and stormwater projects across Newcastle, the Hunter and broader NSW, gaining practical experience that complements your university studies and builds the foundation for your professional career. 
At Maker, we believe in providing a flexible work lifestyle. This has inspired us to change the way we work, leaving behind the traditional 5-day work week. Instead, Maker has adopted a 4-day work week, providing you with a day off during the week and giving you the time to catch up on life and do more of what you love!  
For undergraduate candidates, we offer flexibility around university timetables and exam periods, allowing you to gain consistent industry experience while completing your degree. 
Why join Maker 
Maker is a fast-growing, multi-disciplinary consultancy with more than 65 employees across 4 offices in NSW and Victoria. In addition to Civil Engineering, we specialise in Town Planning, Surveying, and Project Management which provides you with the opportunity to collaborate across a wide range of exciting projects. 
You’ll enjoy:
- Hands-on mentoring from experienced civil engineers, including direct exposure to senior members of our Newcastle team.  
- Real project involvement from the outset - not just observation or administrative tasks.  
- Experience across land development, roads, stormwater, infrastructure and multidisciplinary projects.  
- Opportunities to develop your skills in industry-standard civil design and modelling software.  
- A supportive culture where questions are encouraged and knowledge is shared. 
- The opportunity to grow from undergraduate engineer through to graduate and increasingly independent project responsibilities.  
- A 4-day working week, giving you more time to enjoy life outside work 
- Modern offices and regular team social events 
About the Role 
Located in our Newcastle office and working closely with our Newcastle Principal Civil Engineer, you will be exposed to a variety of projects that will introduce you to a broad range of civil engineering disciplines and progressively build your technical and professional capability. 
Your responsibilities will include: 
- Assisting with the design and documentation of civil infrastructure and land development projects, including roads, earthworks, stormwater drainage and utility infrastructure. 
- Developing practical experience using industry-standard civil design and modelling software. 
- Assisting with engineering calculations, technical assessments and preparation of reports. 
- Working with engineers, surveyors, planners and project managers to understand how projects progress from concept through to construction. 
- Participating in site inspections, project meetings and coordination activities where appropriate. 
You'll be encouraged to ask questions, learn from experienced professionals and progressively take on greater responsibility as your confidence grows. 
For undergraduate candidates, our aim is to provide meaningful, ongoing employment throughout your studies, with flexible part-time arrangements to suit university commitments and the opportunity to transition into a graduate position as you complete your degree. 
About You 
We're looking for someone curious, motivated and excited to build a career in Civil Engineering. 
We're looking for:
- Someone currently studying a Bachelor's degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering, or who has recently graduated from a relevant engineering degree. 
- A genuine interest in civil engineering and a willingness to learn. 
- An interest in design, problem-solving and seeing projects progress from concept through to construction. 
- Good written and verbal communication skills, with an interest in developing your technical writing capability. 
- Good time management, organisation and prioritisation skills. 
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team. 
Whether you're part-way through your degree and looking to build industry experience alongside your studies, or approaching graduation and ready to begin your professional career, we'd like to hear from you. 
Ready to Build Your Career? 
If you're looking to gain meaningful civil engineering experience while completing your degree, or you're ready to take the first step in your graduate career, we'd love to hear from you. 
Please submit your resume and a short cover letter telling us a little about yourself, your studies and why you're interested in joining Maker by clicking the APPLY button.

Civil Designer, 12d Modeller - Roads & Highways | Sunshine Coast
Help shape the future of transport infrastructure across Southeast Queensland.
At Aurecon, we're delivering some of Queensland's most important roads and highways projects. We're looking for a Civil Designer / 12D Modeller to join our Roads team and contribute to the design and delivery of TMR and transport infrastructure projects across the region.
This role is ideally based on the Sunshine Coast, with opportunities for candidates across Southeast Queensland who are open to working from or relocating to the region.
Whether you're an experienced designer or an emerging professional with strong 12D capabilities, we'd love to hear from you.
What you'll do
- Prepare civil road designs and 12D models for transport infrastructure projects
- Work closely with engineers, project managers and other design professionals
- Support the delivery of TMR and Main Roads projects across Southeast Queensland
- Produce high-quality design documentation and technical deliverables
- Contribute to innovative, practical and sustainable infrastructure solutions
What you'll bring
- Experience in civil design and/or 12D modelling within roads and highways projects
- Exposure to TMR/Main Roads projects and standards
- Strong technical skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
- Relevant experience in transport infrastructure, road design or civil engineering projects
- Knowledge of Queensland road design standards and practices
How we support your growth
We believe your career should be a rewarding adventure. You will tackle some of the world's most complex infrastructure challenges, in an environment that supports your ambitions, where we hold ourselves, and each other, to the highest standards. Recognised by the AFR as a Best Place to Work in 2026, we embrace diverse perspectives, giving you the opportunity to make a real impact. 
Who we are 
We are an engineering consultancy with more than 6,000 people across Australia, New Zealand and Asia. We believe the world needs people who can engineer possibilities. They are the ones who can create infrastructure that makes life better for people and the planet. That is our purpose. Bringing ideas to life. This is The Aurecon Way. 
Ready for your next adventure? 
If this sounds like your next step, we'd love to hear from you. We value diverse experiences and welcome applications for part-time or flexible working arrangements. 
Our hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. We're most interested in your individual thinking and experiences-so please ensure your application reflects your authentic perspective.

Seymour Whyte's Graduate Program gives ambitious engineering graduates the opportunity to work on major projects, take on real responsibility from day one, and develop the technical, commercial and leadership skills needed for a successful career in construction.
Through our structured two-year development program, you'll gain hands-on experience across major civil infrastructure projects, work alongside industry leaders, receive dedicated mentoring and build the skills and confidence to accelerate your career.  You'll be trusted with real responsibility, supported to grow and given the opportunity to make a genuine impact while helping deliver infrastructure that connects communities.
If you're ready to learn, grow and help shape the future, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Project
We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Civil Engineer to join our Cressbrook Dam Safety Improvement Project, a major infrastructure upgrade that will strengthen the dam's flood capacity, improve resilience to extreme weather events and enhance long-term community safety.
This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience on a complex and high-profile project while working alongside experienced industry professionals. You'll be exposed to a broad range of civil engineering disciplines and play a meaningful role in delivering infrastructure that will benefit local communities for generations to come.
Located in the picturesque Toowoomba region, this role offers the chance to build your career in a supportive project environment while enjoying the benefits of regional living.
The successful candidate will be required to work away from home, with attractive living away from home (LAFHA) and project allowances provided.
Why Join Seymour Whyte?
At Seymour Whyte, we believe the best way to learn is by doing. Our structured Graduate Development Program is designed to fast-track your career through hands-on project experience, mentoring from industry leaders and tailored professional development opportunities.
From day one, you'll be embedded in a live project team, contributing to the delivery of major infrastructure projects that shape communities across Australia. You'll gain exposure to a range of disciplines, build your technical and commercial acumen and develop the confidence to take ownership of meaningful work early in your career.
Throughout the program, you'll be supported by experienced mentors, participate in structured development workshops, and connect with a national network of graduates and professionals who are invested in your success.
What's in it for you?
- Work on a landmark civil infrastructure project from day one
- Gain exposure to multiple disciplines across project delivery
- Receive structured mentoring, coaching and development support
- Learn from experienced industry leaders and subject matter experts
- Build a strong professional network across projects and regions
- Be part of a collaborative, supportive and high-performing team culture
- Access career opportunities within the VINCI Group, a global leader in construction, infrastructure and concessions
Whether your passion lies in construction delivery, engineering, project management or leadership, our Graduate Development Program will provide the foundation, support and opportunities to help you build a rewarding and long-term career with Seymour Whyte.
To learn more about our Graduate Program, click here.
About You
You're in your final year of a Bachelor of Civil Engineering and ready to turn everything you've learned into real-world experience on major infrastructure projects.
Whether you've gained experience through an internship, vacation work, industry placement or part-time employment, you're eager to learn, build your skills and make a meaningful contribution from day one.
We're looking for graduates who are curious, motivated and excited about a career in civil construction.
You'll bring:
- Final-year studies in a Bachelor of Civil Engineering
- Practical experience through internships, vacation programs, placements or other employment
- A genuine passion for civil construction and infrastructure projects
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced industry professionals
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- A commitment to safety, collaboration and creating a positive team culture
- Flexibility to travel or relocate as opportunities arise throughout your career
Most importantly, you're ready to take the next step, embrace new challenges and build a rewarding career delivering projects that make a lasting impact on communities across Australia.
Seymour Whyte Benefits
- Employee recognition and awards that celebrate contribution and achievement
- An employee share program, providing the opportunity to invest in the long-term success of the business
- Birthday leave, because celebrating life's milestones matters
- The option to purchase additional leave to support travel, study or personal commitments
- Fitness and wellbeing discounts through WHEREFIT (gym memberships, meal plans and fitness brands)
- Travel, retail, lifestyle and wellness discounts
- Workplace banking benefits and everyday financial savings through CommBank and Flare
Seymour Whyte is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, including veterans.
Our commitment to an equitable construction industry extends to an inclusive culture that embraces our differences and gives everyone the opportunity to grow and be equally valued. We're unified in our direction toward having a workplace that is balanced and fair for all.
Next Steps:
- Submit your CV online to apply for this role
- All successful applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment medical and criminal history check
- Applications will only be accepted from candidates who have the right to work in Australia
To learn more about us, visit www.seymourwhyte.com.au

candidates.content_text:
Kickstart Your Career in Engineering Drafting! 
Ready to turn your interest in design and engineering into a career? 
Whether you’re finishing Year 12, recently left school or studying Drafting at TAFE, this is your opportunity to get started in the engineering industry. 
STP Consultants is looking for an enthusiastic Junior Structural Draftsperson to join our growing Brisbane team. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and drafters, gain hands-on experience and learn how the drawings you create become part of real projects across Queensland. 
You don’t need years of experience. We’re looking for someone with the right attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn. 
Why you’ll love working here 
Start building your career   Get hands-on experience from day one and develop practical Structural drafting skills while learning from experienced engineers and drafters. 
Work on real projects   Go beyond the classroom and see how structural engineering projects come together. You’ll contribute to drawings and documentation used throughout projects from concept and design through to delivery. 
Learn from experienced people   Ask questions, share ideas and learn from people who genuinely want to help you develop. You’ll receive guidance and mentoring as your skills and confidence grow. 
Be part of a great team   Join a close-knit, collaborative team where people support each other, work together and enjoy what they do. 
Work in Fortitude Valley   Our Brisbane office is in the heart of Fortitude Valley, close to public transport, cafés, restaurants and everything the city has to offer.
The Opportunity  
As you develop your skills, you’ll have the opportunity to: 
- Assist with preparing structural drawings, plans and project documentation. 
- Work with engineers and experienced drafters to produce clear, accurate and high-quality drawings. 
- Learn industry standards, guidelines and best-practice drafting processes. 
- Develop your understanding of how structural engineering projects are designed and delivered. 
- Participate in project discussions and meetings to build your understanding of project requirements. 
- Carry out basic drawing and documentation checks with guidance from experienced team members. 
- Take on more responsibility as your skills and confidence develop. 
About you: 
You could be a great fit if you are: 
- A Year 12 student, recent school leaver, or currently studying Residential Drafting, or an equivalent qualification at TAFE.
- Genuinely interested in structural drafting, design and engineering. 
- Curious and keen to learn new skills. 
- Detail-oriented and take pride in producing accurate work. 
- A good communicator who is comfortable asking questions and taking feedback. 
- Reliable, organised and willing to have a go at new challenges. 
- Someone who enjoys working with others and being part of a team. 
- An Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident. 
Most importantly, bring your enthusiasm and willingness to learn. We’ll help you turn it into a career. 
What’s in it for you? 
- 
Career development: Build your skills through hands-on experience, mentoring and ongoing professional development. 
- 
Flexibility: Enjoy a 9-day fortnight, flexible working hours and the option to purchase additional leave. 
- 
Competitive remuneration: A package that reflects your experience and contribution. 
- 
Recognition and rewards: Employee referral rewards and recognition programs. 
- 
Great culture: Work with supportive people in a friendly, collaborative environment, with regular team and social events. 
- 
Wellbeing support: Access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program. 
- 
Long-term opportunity: Build your career with an established, Australian-owned engineering consultancy. 
About STP Consultants  
For more than 20 years, STP Consultants has been helping shape communities across Queensland. 
We’re a privately owned, multidisciplinary engineering consultancy, bringing together expertise across Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Hydraulic, Fire and Seismic engineering. Our teams work on a diverse range of projects across Queensland, giving you the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals and see the many different paths an engineering career can take. 
Our values of Potential, Respect, Integrity, Deliver and Engage shape the way we work with our clients and with each other. 
We’re proud of our approachable leaders, supportive team environment and commitment to developing people and delivering quality engineering outcomes. 
Ready to get started?   
If you’re looking for more than just a first job and want to build a career in engineering, we’d love to hear from you. 
Click Apply and send us your Resume and Cover Letter. 
In your cover letter, tell us: 
1. Why you’re interested in starting a career in structural drafting.   
2. What interests you about joining STP Consultants. 
STP Consultants is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

candidates.content_text:
•    A varied role providing end to end support for infrastructure and engineering activities
•    Friendly & supportive team environment
•    Fixed Term position until 30 September 2027
Bring your engineering and project management expertise to the Shire of Capel! As part of our Infrastructure Management directorate, you’ll provide technical support in the assessment, coordination and delivery of engineering and capital works projects, subdivision compliance, contractor management, and extractive industry licensing. 
The Shire of Capel is located in the South West, halfway between Bunbury and Busselton. We are nestled between the beach and the forest and are one of the fastest growing coastal Shires in Australia. At the Shire we value Honesty, Empathy, Accountability, Respect and Teamwork which underpin the way we work with our elected members, the community and each other.
As an Engineering Technical Officer, you will:
•    Provide technical support across civil infrastructure and engineering activities.
•    Support the planning, coordination and delivery of allocated civil infrastructure and capital works projects
•    Coordinate procurement of consultants, contractors and service providers.
•    Provide clear, practical and timely technical information and advice to customers, developers, contractors, consultants, government agencies and internal service areas.
•    Liaise with stakeholders, assist with the preparation of Council reports and support asset management activities.
Whether you’re bringing established expertise or looking to expand your experience, this role offers the chance to grow in civil engineering, project delivery and asset management as part of a supportive team focused on delivering for the community.
As part of our team, you will enjoy:
•    Flexibility and support
•    Investment in you and your career 
•    An inclusive culture where all our people are valued, EEO, diversity and differences are respected
•    A strong focus on employee wellbeing and safety 
•    Full time, 19-day work month 
•    Base annual salary circa $91,767 per annum dependent on skills, experience and qualifications
•    Annual leave loading of 17.5%
•    Up to 14% Shire superannuation contribution
•    Access to Shire pool vehicles for work purposes during business hours
•    Employee benefits program offering a wide range of discounts
For further position related requirements please refer to Position Description – Engineering Technical Officer PDF (293KB). 
If you are viewing this ad in Seek the link may have been removed. Please view this vacancy on our website at capel.wa.gov.au/council/work-with-us.aspx to access the position description.
We embrace diversity and encourage applications from individuals of diverse backgrounds to join us in servicing our community for the future. 
To be considered for this role you will be able to demonstrate:
•    Behaviour that positively demonstrates the Shire’s HEART of: Honesty, Empathy, Accountability, Respect and Teamwork
•    Relevant tertiary qualifications in civil engineering, engineering technology or related discipline.
•    Demonstrated experience in civil engineering, infrastructure, civil construction or a related technical engineering environment.
•    Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply engineering drawings, specifications, standards, guidelines and relevant legislative requirements.
•    Demonstrated experience undertaking technical investigations, assessments and inspections, preparing engineering or project documentation.
•    Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare technical reports and communicate technical requirements to a range of stakeholders.
•    Demonstrated ability to organise and prioritise work and contribute effectively across multiple engineering activities or projects.
•    Strong knowledge of engineering project management practices for municipal infrastructure such as roads, paths, drainage and landscaping.
•    Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant engineering, design, GIS, asset management or corporate systems.
•    Current “C” Class WA Driver’s Licence.
Experience in local government engineering environment and knowledge of relevant legislation and industry standards will be highly regarded. 
Applicants who need assistance with their application or wish to discuss any potential barriers that may prevent them from applying are encouraged to contact People & Culture on 9727 0222 to discuss. 
Further position related enquiries can be directed to Shahin Mahmud, Acting Manager Engineering or People & Culture on 9727 0222.   
Applications close
4:00pm on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
The Shire of Capel reserves the right to commence interviewing prior to the application close date and close this position for applications early should a suitable candidate be found.
